dedupe_keys.name: synthetic smart card data for the analysis of temporal and spatial patterns

description: Synthetic Smart Card Data For The Analysis Of Temporal And Spatial Patterns is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Paul Bouman (Erasmus School of Economics, Erasmus University Rotterdam). This is a synthetic smart card data set that can be used to test pattern detection methods for the extraction of temporal and spatial data. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
